# Nestory: Home Inventory

> Nestory is a free iPhone app that keeps a home's records in one place: every appliance, its warranty, manual, model and serial number, maintenance reminders and repair history. It reminds homeowners before warranties expire and exports the whole home as a PDF report for insurance claims, selling a home, or handing it to a new owner.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6826665963
- Website: https://trynestory.com/
- Price: free, no ads, no tracking
- Platform: iPhone (iOS). Not available on Android yet.
- Made by: Sebastian Gomez, independent developer
- Contact: hello.nestory.app@gmail.com

## Features
- Home health score: one score for how well a home is documented, with the next step to take
- Appliances: photo, category, brand, model and serial number
- Warranties: end dates with reminders 1 week to 3 months before they expire
- Manuals: search online, add a PDF, or scan the paper copy
- Home systems: roof, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, water heater and more, with repair and service history
- Maintenance reminders with phone notifications
- PDF home report for insurance claims and home sales
- More than one home (house, rental, vacation home)
- Data is saved to the user's account, and the account can be deleted inside the app
